node.statement: Exact right inverse for the product: for X=U bold-dot V, the product-norm estimate and 1.2.1 give ||X||^2<=(1+epsilon_r)^2*(16/15)^2<=289/225. If X bold-dot Y=0, exact unitality, the product-norm axiom, the associator axiom, and 1.2.3 imply ||Y||<=||(J-X^dagger bold-dot X) bold-dot Y||+||(X^dagger bold-dot X) bold-dot Y-X^dagger bold-dot (X bold-dot Y)||<=((1+epsilon_r)*3*epsilon_r+epsilon_r||X||^2)||Y||<=(51/256+289/3600)||Y||<(1/2)||Y||. Hence Y=0. Bilinearity makes L_X:Y->X bold-dot Y linear; because the algebra is finite-dimensional, injectivity makes L_X surjective, so some R_X satisfies X bold-dot R_X=J.
